metadata.title: docs: fix release PII tool invocation steps
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## Summary

Updates release-management chapter 12 so the PII plugin verification flow is correct end to end for the current API, plugin config, REST invocation path, MCP transport path, and plugin status endpoint.

## Chapter 12 updates

- Scopes the PII plugin hooks to the tool invocation path: `tool_pre_invoke` and `tool_post_invoke`.
- Keeps the PII plugin in `mode: "enforce"` with partial masking and non-blocking detection.
- Documents the required top-level `tool` wrapper for `POST /tools`.
- Uses the canonical returned tool name, for example `echo-tool`, with JSON-RPC `tools/call` through `/rpc`.
- Removes the AWS access key example because that is secret detection, not PII detection.
- Adds a phone-number PII example instead.
- Expands section 12.3 with concrete Streamable HTTP MCP commands: create virtual server, initialize MCP session, pass `mcp-session-id`, and call `tools/call`.
- Fixes the plugin status endpoint to `/admin/plugins/PIIFilterPlugin` and adds explicit platform-admin token generation for the `admin.plugins` permission.
- Removes the stale `.secrets.baseline` AWS-key false-positive entry after the AWS sample was removed.

## Chapter 12 verification results

Executed against the local compose stack on this branch:

- `make compose-restart`: passed; gateway replicas came up healthy behind nginx.
- Created REST echo tool with the documented `POST /tools` payload shape.
- `/rpc` JSON-RPC `tools/call` results:
  - SSN input `123-45-6789` returned masked as `***-**-6789`.
  - Credit card input `4111-1111-1111-1111` returned masked as `****-****-****-1111`.
  - Email input `john.doe@example.com` returned masked as `j******@example.com`.
  - Phone input `212-555-0199` returned masked as `***-***-0199`.
- AWS access key input was intentionally removed from the PII docs because the PII plugin does not treat it as PII; AWS credentials are the responsibility of secret-detection controls.
- MCP Streamable HTTP path passed:
  - Created a virtual server for the echo tool.
  - Initialized `/servers/{server_id}/mcp/` with `MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-11-25`.
  - Called `tools/call` with the returned `mcp-session-id`.
  - SSN input was masked in the upstream httpbin payload.
- Plugin status API passed:
  - A non-admin token returned `403` with `Admin privileges required`, confirming 12.4 needs an admin token.
  - A generated platform-admin token let `/admin/plugins/PIIFilterPlugin` return `status: enabled` and `mode: enforce`.
  - Hooks included `tool_pre_invoke` and `tool_post_invoke`.
- `make compose-logs | grep -i plugin` showed plugin startup/router messages and no plugin error lines.

## Docs verification

- Installed docs dependencies in `docs/.venv` using PyPI because the default `uv` index could not resolve `certifi>=2026.4.22`.
- `cd docs && . .venv/bin/activate && mkdocs build`: passed.
- `cd docs && . .venv/bin/activate && mkdocs build --strict`: not claimed for this PR; unrelated strict-link warnings were split into #4523.
- Opened the built page locally at `http://127.0.0.1:8017/development/release-management/#122-test-pii-detection-on-tool-invocation` and confirmed the rendered chapter 12 shows the corrected tool payload, phone example, MCP commands, and plugin status endpoint.
